title: astragalus ammophilus subsp. persepolitanus
intro: Astragalus ammophilus subsp. persepolitanus, commonly known as the Persian astragalus, is a plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus ammophilus subsp. persepolitanus include immunomodulation, antioxidant activity, and antiviral effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
